rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education programs approved by the Board (not in-service, on-the-job training, CPR/BCLS, programs open to the public or medical school courses)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours may be prorated at 1.25 clock-hours per month for licensure periods shorter than two years.
rules.notes: Two-year licensure period ends June 30. Includes a 1-clock-hour course provided by the Board (subject not stated in the rule). CPE Monitor tracks CE; proof of programs not in CPE Monitor goes to the Board within 30 days.
